messages:
ryan_cs: FYI velox-pay hitting 429s on SDK bootstrap in eu-west after they flip a small canary. Seems like a short-lived spike ~350 clients in ~25s.

ryan_cs: Example response they pasted: ```POST /v1/sdk/init HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.example
x-request-id: vel-req-77
Response: 429 Too Many Requests
x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rate-limit-reset: 10
```

velox-ops: We use the browser SDK via an edge worker. Default bootstrap config, and we rotate ephemeral creds every 15s for security. No jitter on init.

anika_eng: Aggressive ephemeral TTL + zero splay = classic stampede. Quick customer guidance: increase ephemeralTTL to >=120s, add randomized client splay on init (200-800ms), and avoid in-lockstep worker restarts during deploys.

dev_sam: Also ask them to enable connection reuse on the edge worker (keepAlive/http2) so the init requests aren't N new TCP/TLS handshakes. Example snippet to patch their worker: ```// edge worker pseudo
fetch(url, { keepalive: true, headers: { 'connection': 'keep-alive' } })```

claire_infra: Infra traces show auth-validate QPS for account velox jumped to 3.6k and auth queue depth briefly spiked. Short-term we can enable "validation coalescing" for this account to dedupe identical ephemeral checks for 8s. I can toggle a flag for a 20m window.

onboard-bot: Ticket created: CS-#5309 "VeloxPay SDK init 429s (canary)". Assigned to anika_eng, claire_infra. ETA for flag rollout: ~12m. Playbook: https://confluence.redwood/integration-playbooks/bootstrap-mitigation (internal).

ryan_cs: I'll ask Velox to flip ephemeralTTL to 180 and add a 0-800ms jitter for the canary. Tell them to hold at 10% for 3m while we enable coalescing.

velox-ops: Changing TTL to 180 and adding client jitter now. Rolling 10% -> 100% over 4m if green. Will post any x-request-id if failures continue.

anika_eng: If 429s persist after client mitigations, we need two failing x-request-id values and a snapshot of `x-active-clients` and `x-client-conns` headers so we can correlate to auth queue traces.

dev_sam: Long-term SDK action item: add an `initSplayMs` option and `ephemeralDefaultSeconds` so customers can opt-in without custom shims. Filing a GH issue.

claire_infra: Flag toggled for velox account; monitoring now. If we see auth queue normalize, we'll close the flag after 20m and follow up with postmortem notes.

ryan_cs: Thanks all. Logging into account health. Will mark resolved when Velox confirms green. :white_check_mark:
